stem: Which statement best describes why Texas experiences more hurricanes in August than in January?

options.label: A
options.text: Wind speeds are slower in August than in January.

options.label: B
options.text: Wave heights are greater in August than in January.

options.label: C
options.text: Rainfall amounts are lower in August than in January.

options.label: D
options.text: Ocean temperatures are higher in August than in January.
